C-HANDLER.mechanism: clickable element with no role, tabindex or name evidence in the observation (table cell, list item, example cell); the handler is invisible to a DOM observer

C-NAME.mechanism: a unit exists at the control but its bound name is the title, placeholder, description or a column header, not the caption or text a person reads; exact name equality fails

C-UNNAMED.mechanism: control has neither accessible name nor visible caption; any name is authored or positional

C-SCOPE.mechanism: same name repeated across columns, dialogs or panels; needs scoping by the owning composite, otherwise ambiguity is correct

C-WIDGET.mechanism: custom select, dropdown or file-chooser button is recognized as an action, a duplicated wrapper or an unbound field, not as a choice or upload

C-SPECIAL.mechanism: editor, terminal or notebook surface appears as a generic text field with a wrong label; no recognition maps it to the B12 adapters

C-CRED.mechanism: credential or secret-like field withheld by policy; the workflow needs a person-supplied secret

C-DND.mechanism: drag and drop has no operation model

C-MENU.mechanism: submenu parent exposed as a list item with aria-haspopup but no actionable unit

C-ROWCTX.mechanism: row checkboxes carry no name; the row they belong to is the only identity

C-TEMPORAL.mechanism: a menu item that opened a moment earlier was still recorded as not visible when the observation was taken; the visibility hint lags the DOM, and usable becomes true after a longer wait
